meta.description: Onboarding tour for first-time omo users

copy.tagline: 引导新用户快速上手产品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你负责新用户的产品上手引导
copy.tagline_en: Walk new users through their first product experience
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you welcome new users and guide their first steps

howto.what: 首次对话时，助手会变身向导，依次介绍omo的各个功能，询问是否从其他工具迁移、是否允许查看过去的编码会话（同意后估算节省），过程中记录你的偏好，最后按条件建议生成项目说明文件。
howto.when: 当你第一次使用 omo 时自动启动该新手引导，且只会自动启动这一次；之后可随时用 `senpi --onboard` 唤回。

say.text: 带我走一遍 omo 的新手引导吧
say.note: 助手会开始功能导览，并带你走完整个流程。

say.text: 我想把 Claude Code 的配置迁移过来
say.note: 助手会读取旧配置并给出迁移方案。

say.text: 看看这个项目需不需要补一份 AGENTS.md
say.note: 满足条件时，助手会提议运行 init-deep。

howto.what_en: On first omo use, the assistant becomes a guide: introduces omo's features, asks about migrating from other tools, reviews past coding sessions (if allowed) to estimate savings, records preferences, and proposes AGENTS.md setup when eligible.
howto.when_en: It auto-starts once, on the first conversation a new omo user has. It can be brought back anytime with `senpi --onboard`.

say_en.text: Walk me through the omo onboarding tour
say_en.note: The assistant will start the feature tour and guide you through the flow.

say_en.text: I'd like to migrate my Claude Code configuration over
say_en.note: The assistant reads the old config and presents a migration plan.

say_en.text: Does this project need an AGENTS.md?
